# FocusReps

> FocusReps is an iPhone focus timer that turns every break into push-ups. You work in a focus session (default 25 minutes), then the iPhone camera counts your push-ups during the break (default 10 reps). Pose detection runs on-device. No account, no video stored, nothing leaves the phone. Requires iOS 17.0 or later.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone, App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/focus-push-up-set-focusreps/id6827547307
- Camera rep counter: on-device pose detection, a rep counts only when shoulders drop well below plank height and come back up
- Deep Focus: blocks distracting apps during a focus session
- Stats: weekly push-ups and focus time, Home Screen widget, Game Center leaderboard
- HealthKit sync: optional, off by default
- Privacy: no account, no login, no video stored or uploaded
- Exercises: push-ups in the current version
- Browser demo: https://focusreps.app/?demo

## Pages

- [ADHD focus planner](https://focusreps.app/tools/adhd-focus-planner/): one-page printable PDF, no email
- [30 day push-up challenge](https://focusreps.app/tools/30-day-pushup-challenge/): one-page printable PDF, 10 to 50 reps, no email
